dataset.name: EV battery charging snippets, Zhang et al. (Tsinghua/PKU), figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.23659323
dataset.paper: Zhang et al., Realistic fault detection of Li-ion battery via dynamical deep learning, Nature Communications 14:5940 (2023), doi:10.1038/s41467-023-41226-5
dataset.snippet: 128 consecutive readings, 10 s apart (~21 minutes of one charge); several snippets per charge
dataset.label: 1 = vehicle labelled faulty by the dataset authors (per vehicle; the paper says labels come from drivers' reports confirmed by engineers, and that data at or near the failure were removed). Faults, not fires: nothing here predicts fire.
dataset.caveat: Very small samples (9 faulty cars in brand 3, 16 in brand 2). Results are indicative only; confidence intervals are wide.

how_verified: column.pkl shipped inside each brand archive lists exactly these names in this order (read with a restricted unpickler)
the authors' code (DyAD/model/tasks.py, github.com/962086838/Battery_fault_detection_NC_github) selects inputs by these names via column.pkl

value checks on every reading (checks_per_brand, shares of readings): max cell >= min cell, max temp >= min temp, cell voltages in the Li-ion range, SOC within 0-100 and non-decreasing within a snippet, current <= 0 (charging is negative), timestamps 10 s apart
column_mapping.not_used: 'volt' is the pack voltage on a brand-specific scale (brand 3 ~10.7x the mean cell voltage, brand 2 below it), so no feature uses it
column_mapping.byte_order: the pickles store little-endian float64; numpy keeps that order on big-endian s390x, so values were read correctly (no torch involved)

car_features.log_spread_median: log of the median (over snippets) of the mean max-min cell-voltage spread, mV
car_features.log_spread_p95: log of the 95th percentile of the per-snippet maximum spread, mV
car_features.log_spread_mid_soc: log of the median spread while SOC is 40-80% (less dependent on where charging starts)
car_features.spread_iqr_mv: interquartile range of the per-snippet mean spread, mV
car_features.spread_trend_rho: Spearman correlation of snippet spread with mileage (drift over the history)
car_features.spread_late_minus_early_mv: median spread of the last 30% of snippets minus the first 30%, mV
car_features.spread_growth_median_mv: median growth of the spread within a snippet (last quarter minus first), mV
car_features.temp_spread_median_c: median of the mean max-min temperature difference, C
car_features.temp_max_p95_c: 95th percentile of the snippet maximum temperature, C
car_features.vmax_rise_p95_mv_per_min: 95th percentile of the rise rate of the highest cell voltage, mV/min
car_features.log_snippets: log number of snippets (amount of history)
car_features.mileage_span: odometer range covered by the history (brand-specific units)
car_features.soc_start_median: median SOC at the start of a snippet, %
car_features.soc_range_median: median SOC gained within a snippet, %
car_features.high_spread_share: share of snippets whose max spread is above the brand's high-spread level (median over training cars of each car's 95th percentile)

models.logistic: L2 logistic regression, C=0.1, class_weight balanced, on per-brand robust-scaled features
models.boosting: gradient boosting, 100 trees of depth 2, learning rate 0.05, subsample 0.8, min 3 cars per leaf, balanced sample weights
models.spread_only_logistic: the drift hypothesis on its own: logistic regression (as above) on the cell-voltage spread features only (log_spread_median, log_spread_p95, log_spread_mid_soc, spread_iqr_mv, spread_trend_rho, spread_late_minus_early_mv, spread_growth_median_mv, high_spread_share)
models.spread_median_only: baseline: the car's median cell-voltage spread, nothing fitted
models.usage_only_logistic: confounder check: logistic regression on usage features only

evaluation_design.unit: car (every metric is per vehicle; all snippets of a car are on the same side of a split)
evaluation_design.cross_validation: 20 repeats of stratified 5-fold over cars (strata brand x label)
evaluation_design.threshold: score reached by 10% of normal training cars, from out-of-fold scores of an inner 4-fold split of the training cars
evaluation_design.roc_auc: mean over repeats of the pooled out-of-fold AUC; 95% CI from 2000 car bootstraps stratified by label (the same resampled cars in every repeat)
evaluation_design.flag_rates: each car's share of repeats in which it was flagged, averaged over faulty cars (recall) or normal cars (false-flag rate); precision = expected flagged faulty / expected flagged
evaluation_design.p_one_sided_mann_whitney: approximate: Mann-Whitney test of repeat-averaged out-of-fold scores
evaluation_design.fixed_before_results: features, model settings, budget, folds and repeats were set before any evaluation was run and were not tuned on the results; the spread-only model and the mileage-adjusted check were added after a first (2-repeat) run to see what drives the signal

early_warning.definition: held-out cars described only by snippets with mileage <= first + 50% of their mileage range (at least the first 10 snippets)

history_capped_check.definition: every car summarised from at most 100 snippets evenly spread over its mileage-ordered history

mileage_adjusted_check.definition: every car feature replaced by its residual from a per-brand linear fit on the car's median mileage, fitted on the training cars of each fold (no labels); asks whether the signal survives once age (odometer) is accounted for
